messages:
raj: Quick thought — can we show a per-role 'estimated routing & quota impact' sparkline on the Role detail panel? Small visual that says expected token usage delta if role enabled for an endpoint.

tess: ooh yes. Helps sales + customer eng when onboarding. How do we compute estimate though? Today routing decisions live in the runtime service.

olivia: we have two data sources: recent per-route token rates (metrics svc) and role->route bindings from auth svc. Combine them to estimate.

sam: prefer to compute server-side and cache at role-level. Avoid console hitting runtime on each render. Also want TTL invalidation when config changes.

raj: agreed. proposal: telemetry-api returns {role_id, estimate_tokens_per_min, routing_affinity_score} — console renders sparkline. TTL 5m. If user clicks 'refresh' we trigger re-fetch.

mia: UX ask: add microcopy explaining "estimate = last 24h from active routes bound to this role; not guaranteed". :question: 

olivia: API debate: metrics svc has 1m granularity, auth svc has eventual consistency. do we do join in telemetry svc or in console? join in telemetry svc so we can apply sampling/aggregate rules.

sam: also need to respect tenant isolation. telemetry svc must filter per-tenant and honor scope propagation. Add an internal flag for dedicated/private customers to include model-variant costs.

deploy-bot: deploy request #4576 — telemetry-svc: add role-estimates endpoint — queued for canary

tess: rollout plan: start behind feature-flag for 5% orgs, add A/B for 'show sparkline' vs 'no sparkline' to measure support ticket delta and dashboard latency.

raj: measurement metrics: console render p95, number of API calls per page, support tickets mentioning 'confusing role cost'. Also add analytic event when people click the sparkline.

mia: small nit — accessibility: use aria-labels and alt text for small sparkline. Also tooltip with numeric estimate.

olivia: implementation note: GraphQL gateway can stitch telemetry role estimate into RoleQuery. Should we return both the sparkline image data and numeric series? prefer numeric series to allow client rendering and A11y.

sam: performance: if we return 60-point series per role and page shows 10 roles, that's 600 datapoints. fine but add pagination and bundle into a single POST to telemetry endpoint.

raj: security: ensure role estimates endpoint validates scopes: only 'role.read' allowed, no elevation. Add audit entry when estimate requested for enterprise tenants.

tess: UX copy for tooltip draft: "Estimated tokens per minute for routes currently assigned to this role (last 24h). This is an estimate used for planning; actual usage varies with traffic and routing policies." OK?

mia: looks good. @sam can you make the API PR? @olivia can you do the telemetry svc change? I'll mock the UI in Figma and ship the copy.

sam: on it. I'll include TTL and per-tenant feature flag in the PR.

olivia: will add integration tests and sampling config.

raj: thanks team. Follow-up: add a small experiment to surface 'estimated $/hr' for billing-linked customers later.

tess: :thumbsup: moving to action items.
